subject: SUPERSEDE: cover-route reassert single-flight is not dominant gap
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-performance-rd-cover-route-reassert-lifecycle-20261002. NEGATIVE_RESULT: the initial starvation hypothesis was materially weakened by shell source review. COVER_PANEL_LEASE_V3 operations 1/2/3/4/5 all execute through runCoverMutation -> one coverMutationExecutor; therefore an old ensure-held mutation and a new prewarm mutation are serialized, and the old binder result normally becomes postable before the new prewarm result can complete. Exact V3 token checks also prevent an old ensure-held request from mutating a changed lease. The global coverRouteReassertInFlight flag remains inelegant and a scheduler-reordering edge is not formally impossible, but current evidence does not justify it as the dominant independent gap. Superseding the focus/claim rather than escalating a false positive. No production change recommended from this hypothesis alone.
